provision of ₹90.50
lakh was the net effect
of increase of
₹711.80 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹802.30 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amounts
in conference,
workshop and
seminar, gratuitous
grants,
commercial/Arts/tech
nical services,
electricity charges,
Publications and
Printing, legal charges
and medical
reimbursement.
Decrease was
attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
